facts.fact: Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbaiba of the Government of National Unity launched the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2026-2030 at a ceremony on 1 June 2026, together with the AI Ethics Charter, per LANA citing the Prime Minister's Media Office.

The strategy carries a timeframe and phased performance indicators and digital targets (80% of government entities using AI, national digital identity active for 70% of the population, 10,000 staff trained, 100 AI start-ups, 50% of government transactions automated, 70% of paper records digitised), with no cost stated, per LANA citing the Prime Minister's Media Office.
The Prime Minister launched the strategy and the AI Ethics Charter on 1 June 2026, per LANA.
